claude.sample_unit: deidentified clinical notes (Study 1); 56 clinical spans (Study 2); 84 terms (Study 3)

links.outcome: Reference-matched linking of known-concept spans under complete retrieval versus masked retrieval versus LLM-only inference
links.effect: Complete retrieval linked 28/28 known-concept spans (100%; 95% CI 87.9%-100%); masking assigned POSSIBLE_CANDIDATES to all 28; LLM-only linked 3/28 (10.7%).
links.quote: In Study 2, complete retrieval returned a reference-matched link for 28/28 known-concept spans (100%; 95% CI, 87.9%-100%).
